description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmployeeLanguageDao' responsible for managing employee language records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching employee language data, and interacts with the database using Doctrine ORM.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for handling database operations related to employee language data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeLanguage entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeLanguage record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeLanguageRecordsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing language and fluency records for a given employee, based on provided entries.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Deletes specified language records for an employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeLanguage entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeLanguage records matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Fetches a list of allowed languages for an employee, based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed languages for an employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for employee languages based on search filters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for allowed employee languages based on filter parameters.
